palette: Totoy 36, hard alpha; no reserved gold x,y or red z,A
scale: 1x game pixels (nearest-neighbour; preview sheets are scaled copies)
status: Reference art for the human's approval; not imported into art/src, not wired into the game
weapon: Chain Scythe (suggested skill name: Reaper's Coil)
layout: 10 columns x 1 row of 64x64 cells, feet anchor (32,56) in every cell. Right-facing; mirror around the anchor for left.

poses.description: idle / ready: scythe upright in the lead fist, blade over the head; the chain loops up into the other fist
walk: haft gripped low in the lead fist, trailed up over the back with the blade hanging behind
combo 1: wide horizontal sweep, two-handed grip
combo 2: reverse (backhand) rising arc, two-handed grip
combo 3: overhead-to-low slam, both fists together on the haft, blade skims the ground
charged: the raised fist whirls the scythe on its chain in a full circle overhead
skill wind-up: haft drawn back in the rear fist, chain gathered in the lead fist
skill: whip-out, the chain flies forward out of the lead fist (the scythe is far ahead, see the fx sheet)
skill: drag, leaning back, the taut chain runs through both fists, slack loop below
recovery: scythe lowered across the hips in both fists, blade trailing behind

colours.haft: h stone_4 with t teal_1 ferrules, j stone_6 pommel ring
colours.blade: u teal_2 body, t teal_1 spine, 1 cream cutting edge (concave side), p water_6 tip
colours.chain: alternating links: j/1 face-on (2 px across) and u/t edge-on (1 px), ink outline 0
colours.effects: 1 cream, p water_6, 7 grass_6 glints, u teal_2, t teal_1, k water_1 deep blue-black shadow

request: Chain Scythe: wide sweeping arcs, charged full-circle spin on the chain; right-click Reaper's Coil whips the chain out, hooks the golem, drags it to Totoy and staggers it. Damage, timing, cost, cooldown and stagger length are owner/core decisions.
